verdict.rationale: The official README says Gemini CLI can 'run non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation'. It also documents machine-readable output via `--output-format json` and `--output-format stream-json`, and describes automated GitHub workflows such as PR review and issue triage. Community feedback corroborates the automated code-review workflow. Missing for 10: the headless invocation syntax (e.g. a prompt flag), exit-code and CI authentication behavior, and independent hands-on reports of scripted, non-interactive use specifically.
